contexts.text: Everyone's love is like spongy and porous wood...
The things in the atmospheres from the earth, man absorbs... through the pores of the whole body. WE 1457.
(Plants) freely drink in these things through their little mouths, pores, and ducts...
Some (of the excretions) are cast out as excrementitious through the pores of the skin.
a. (The Sirens were carried) through the pores of the bone of the skull towards the external skin...
